messages.subject: example model
parts:
data {
int N;
int K;
vector[N] y;
matrix[N,K] X;
}
parameters {
vector[K] b;
real<lower=0> sigma_1;
real<lower=0> sigma_2;
}
transformed parameters {
real<lower=0> sigma;
sigma <- sqrt (pow(sigma_1, 2) + pow(sigma_2, 2));
}
model {
y ~ normal (X*b, sigma);
}
